0022600039.text: The Utah Jazz (1-10, 0-5 on the road, 15th in the West) visit the Houston Rockets (8-3, 5-1 at home, 5th in the West) in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup, with Utah on a nine-game losing streak. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture), while Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the most recent meeting came on April 3, 2026, in Houston, when the Jazz lost 140-106 in a regular-season game.
